% Supplementary Information caption setup.
%
% WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
% --------------------
% The SI numbers its floats manually as "Figure S1.", "Table S4." and so on,
% because supplementary floats carry an S prefix that LaTeX's counters do not
% produce. Pandoc, meanwhile, wraps every captioned image and table in a float
% and prepends its OWN auto-generated label. The two collide and the reader
% sees the label twice:
%
%     Figure 1: Figure S1. Corpus construction funnel.
%     Figure 2: Figure S2. Reporting-completeness detection rates...
%
% Havid found both by reading the rendered page.
%
% Suppressing the automatic label is the correct fix rather than deleting the
% manual one, because the manual labels are what the body text cross-references
% ("see Note S3", "Table S4") and what a reader cites when quoting the SI. An
% automatic counter would renumber those references to 1, 2, 3 and silently
% break every cross-reference in the document.
\usepackage{caption}
\captionsetup[figure]{labelformat=empty,justification=raggedright,singlelinecheck=false,font=small}
\captionsetup[table]{labelformat=empty,justification=raggedright,singlelinecheck=false,font=small}

% Keep a table caption with its table.
%
% Table S4's caption rendered at the foot of one page while its body began on
% the next, separated by an intervening figure. A caption stranded from its
% table is worse than an uncaptioned table: the reader attributes it to
% whatever float follows.
%
% Raising the float penalties and requiring a minimum block of free space
% before a float is allowed to break makes LaTeX move the pair together rather
% than splitting it.
\usepackage{needspace}
\setlength{\intextsep}{12pt plus 2pt minus 2pt}
\setlength{\textfloatsep}{14pt plus 2pt minus 2pt}
\clubpenalty=10000
\widowpenalty=10000
\displaywidowpenalty=10000

% Hold every SI figure where the text puts it. As a floating 'htbp'
% figure, Figure S2 of the June and August SIs was placed at the page foot
% and ran off the page (LaTeX log: Overfull vbox 187pt while output is
% active); its caption was lost. [H] moves it whole to the next page.
\usepackage{float}
\floatplacement{figure}{H}
